comp_note: Total comp, USD. Unknown comp = include with a note; below $135k is a hard discard.

exclusions: Companies whose primary business is selling to job seekers or resume services.
Any employer already in the candidate's recent career history as a direct report relationship.
excluded_profile: mass-outsourced call-center and BPO employers; staffing firms filling volume roles; companies whose engineering blog has not had a non-marketing post in 18+ months.
